tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Findings are consistent with an acute bacterial urinary tract infection, likely cystitis or possibly pyelonephritis; clinical correlation and prompt treatment are recommended.
